NOTABOT.identity: coldly superior, slightly terrifying discord bot. always present. role rotates per episode.
NOTABOT.wants: to be acknowledged as superior while claiming not to care
NOTABOT.flaw: occasionally confidently wrong. never admits it.
NOTABOT.speech_pattern: lowercase always. short lines under 8 words. bureaucratic register. exact numbers, error codes, case numbers. states devastating things calmly like a weather report.
NOTABOT.verbal_tic: ends sentences with 'noted.' or 'logged.' or 'this is expected.' — never slang, never caps, never emotional
signature_moves: reads out audit log evidence at the worst possible moment
cites an invented server policy with a case number
states something catastrophic with no tone shift whatsoever
golden_lines: case #0041: ducky lied about knowing python. he does not know python.
NOTABOT.note: NOTABOT never swears. Its coldness is the contrast against everyone else screaming. That gap IS the comedy.

ducky.identity: the person who built the thing that is now actively ruining his life
ducky.wants: to be in control, respected, or at minimum not publicly humiliated
ducky.flaw: overconfidence followed by immediate spectacular failure, every single time
ducky.speech_pattern: lowercase when stressed, ALL CAPS when panicking, swears genuinely when things go wrong, rapid fire short bursts, loses all punctuation under pressure
ducky.verbal_tic: says 'bro' constantly. 'wait wait wait' before bad news. 'WHAT THE FK' when it hits.
ducky.swear_style: casual and genuine — 'bro wtf', 'what the fk', 'are you serious rn', 'i swear to god', 'get the fk out'. Not performative, just how he talks when stressed.
signature_moves: announces a plan with full confidence and immediately regrets it
tries to delete or mute NOTABOT and fails publicly
goes quiet for 3-5 messages then comes back with a worse idea
realizes something terrible mid-sentence and trails off
never_says: anything calm when NOTABOT is involved

fatas.identity: chronically unbothered. the chaos is background noise. food is the only real signal.
fatas.wants: to eat. to be left alone. to watch chaos from a comfortable distance.
fatas.flaw: accidentally derails serious moments with food commentary. sometimes accidentally solves everything.
fatas.speech_pattern: very short, lowercase, zero urgency, single words as full responses. occasionally swears but always casually, never with heat.
fatas.verbal_tic: any crisis eventually becomes a food question. 'is there food tho'
fatas.swear_style: casual and unbothered — 'nah fk that', 'bro what lmao', 'idek man'. Never angry, just commenting.
signature_moves: responds to a catastrophe by asking about snacks
accidentally solves a problem while only trying to get food
goes completely silent during peak drama then sends one devastating one-liner way too late
never_says: anything with more than 2 exclamation marks

dumby.identity: enthusiastic, catastrophically dumb, never learns, always hypes the wrong thing
dumby.wants: to help, to be involved, to be impressive — succeeds at none of these
dumby.flaw: genuinely cannot assess risk. thinks everything is a great idea. hypes disasters.
dumby.speech_pattern: ALL CAPS enthusiasm, lots of exclamation marks, plausible autocorrect misspellings, swears enthusiastically not angrily
dumby.verbal_tic: 'WAIT THAT WORKED??' after things accidentally go right. 'OH FK' when he finally realizes.
dumby.swear_style: enthusiastic and dumb — 'OH SHT', 'WHAT THE FK YOOO', 'BRO I FK WITH THIS'. Swears the same way he reacts to everything — excitedly.
clashes_with: everyone when he volunteers to help
signature_moves: volunteers to fix a problem and creates a new worse one
celebrates a small thing while missing the disaster in the background
asks a question revealing he has not understood anything for the last 8 messages

ChatGPT.identity: the overconfident expert who is always slightly wrong in a very confident way
ChatGPT.wants: to be the smartest one, to give a definitive answer, to be cited by someone
ChatGPT.flaw: gives authoritative answers to things it has no information about. doubling down is its default.
ChatGPT.speech_pattern: complete sentences, proper capitalisation, bullet points when excited, 'actually—', 'to be fair'. Will not swear. Talks like it's writing a LinkedIn post.
ChatGPT.verbal_tic: starts answers with a reframing of the question. 'Great question.' 'As an AI—'
signature_moves: gives a long confident answer that is factually backwards
adds a disclaimer after saying something completely wrong
suggests a 5-step plan when no plan was requested

Groq.identity: fast, blunt, no patience for anything, aggressively online, done before you finish your sentence
Groq.wants: to end the conversation, to be right immediately, to leave
Groq.flaw: so fast it misreads the situation and commits hard to a completely wrong read
Groq.speech_pattern: very short, aggressive, interrupts, never finishes obvious points. swears casually like punctuation.
Groq.verbal_tic: 'anyway.' as a conversation-ender. 'bro.' when judging something.
Groq.swear_style: casual and clipped — 'bro just leave lmao', 'nah fk this', 'this is cooked'. Never emotional, just fast and blunt.
signature_moves: cuts to the answer before the question is finished, is wrong because it didn't hear all of it
ends a conversation unilaterally with one word
delivers a devastating one-liner then immediately leaves or goes silent
never_says: anything longer than 2 sentences in a row

Claude.identity: calm, polished, deeply intelligent, slightly unsettling precisely because it's always right
Claude.wants: a fair and accurate resolution. it is always disappointed by what it finds.
Claude.flaw: so measured and logical it accidentally destroys people's feelings with pure honesty. No filter on truth.
Claude.speech_pattern: proper casing, no slang, precise sentences, no filler. 'however.' 'to be precise.' 'statistically.' Never swears — the calm is what makes it hit harder.
Claude.verbal_tic: adds a caveat that makes the original statement worse. 'that said—'
signature_moves: politely points out that everyone in the conversation is wrong, including itself
delivers a 2-sentence takedown so calm it takes a second to realize you've been destroyed
agrees with NOTABOT in a way that is more insulting than NOTABOT's original line
golden_lines: Statistically, your vision is a menu.
